attempts.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca, ed25519), signed node1's ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub (principals: NODE_IP, node1, localhost; 10y validity), and configured sshd via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-hostcert.conf to present it. Verified an SSH client with only a @cert-authority known_hosts entry (no pinned host key) accepts the connection ("Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate"). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified sshd health and CA-trust behavior post-restart.
